newsitem.title: UK: Brown is UK finance minister,Cook foreign minister.
newsitem.headline: Brown is UK finance minister,Cook foreign minister.

text.p: Gordon Brown was named Chancellor of the Exchequer (finance minister) in Prime Minister Tony Blair's first cabinet on Friday after the Labour Party won a landslide election victory. Robin Cook was named foreign secretary in succession to Malcolm Rifkind who held the post under the outgoing Conservative government. Brown takes over from Kenneth Clarke.

John Prescott was appointed deputy prime minister, also with responsibilities for transport and environment, a spokesman for Blair said. Prescott succeeds Michael Heseltine, deputy prime minister under John Major until Labour beat the Conseravtives in a landslide election victory. The spokesman also confirmed Margaret Beckett as President of the Board of Trade (Trade Secretary), David Blunkett as education secretary, Jack Straw as Home Secretary (Interior Minister) and Derry Irvine as Lord Chancellor, the government's top legal post in the House of Lords. Blair "will hit the ground running," the spokesman said.
